en: The postcard features a woman in traditional Badische (Baden) folk costume from the Furtwangen area, Amt Triberg, located in the Black Forest (Schwarzwald), Germany. The woman is shown in side profile wearing an elaborate dress with a distinctive hat adorned with yellow pom-poms, a common attribute of the Black Forest traditional attire. The background is plain with text underneath the image.
